about: SimulaGPU project execution ledger. Engineering truth for autonomous agents: what is done, ready, wip, blocked, and what is next. This file is NOT the pedagogical source of truth. Learning order, concepts, and learner outcomes live in docs/curriculum/manifest.ts. Curriculum-track items here reference a curriculumId and MUST NOT fork curriculum truth. See docs/project/README.md.
globalDefinitionOfDone: AGENTS.md § Definition of done. In short: pnpm verify passes; learner-facing text is Spanish with accents; engineering text is English; new teaching models are pure, frozen, JSON-serializable and unit-tested; no generated file is committed; no unmeasured performance or CUDA claim; no reference repository is modified.

items.title: Clase 0 — El modelo mental de una GPU
definitionOfDone: Global DoD.
Deliberately a reduced vertical slice: prerequisite-free, code-free conceptual introduction. No native code, no exercise, no Anki cards by design (see AGENTS.md and the lesson scope note).

definitionOfDone: Global DoD.

Reuses the vector-add native context; allocation has no useful standalone CPU oracle, so no dedicated native core is required (documented).

items.title: Primitiva C — __syncthreads()
definitionOfDone: Global DoD (pnpm verify green).
Spanish learner-facing lesson under apps/docs/ with a scope note: it is a deterministic explanatory model, not a CUDA executor or hardware scheduler.
Deterministic, frozen, JSON-serializable core model in packages/core with determinism, serialization, immutability, normalization, URL round-trip, and boundary unit tests.

Vue visualization in packages/visuals showing before/waiting/released barrier states, explicit block-local scope, and an invalid divergent-participation case; accessible and mobile-first per AGENTS.md interactive primitive contract.
Anki cards under anki/cards for retention.

Native material only if the primitive contract requires it; __syncthreads() has no useful standalone CPU oracle, so a dedicated native example is not mandatory — document this explicitly, mirroring Primitive A.
Update docs/curriculum/manifest.ts: set primitive-c status to 'implemented' with implementation references (docPath, route, references); the publishing rule forbids a public route until then.
Add link coverage for the new module (tests/lesson-links.test.ts or equivalent).
items.note: Not started on main. An exploratory branch 'class/primitves' exists but is not integrated into main and its completeness is unverified; treat primitive-c as not started. Do NOT record DONE without inspectable evidence on the committed branch.

items.title: CPU-only native foundation with optional CUDA detection
definitionOfDone: Global DoD.
native/ builds and runs CTest with no CUDA installed; CUDA is optional and detected, never assumed.
CI runs the CPU-only path with SIMULAGPU_CUDA=OFF and no GPU hardware.

items.title: Deterministic Anki build pipeline (TSV + web JSON)
definitionOfDone: Global DoD.
Two runs produce byte-identical output (verified in CI via --check).
Sources validated against anki/schema/card.schema.json; card ids unique and permanent.

items.title: Interactive Anki card reviewer in the browser
definitionOfDone: Global DoD.
Deterministic reviewer consuming the generated web JSON; local-only progress under simulagpu:v1:learner; unit tested.

items.title: Mobile-first reading, fullscreen focus, and responsive sidebar
definitionOfDone: Global DoD.
Primary reading and Anki review paths work down to ~360 px without horizontal page scroll; responsive course sidebar toggle; no interaction requires hover.

items.title: Landing page and class selector
definitionOfDone: Global DoD.
Landing exposes only real, implemented routes; planned curriculum ids and titles never leak into landing or VitePress config (guarded by tests).

items.title: Project execution layer: roadmap ledger, resolver CLI, and tests
definitionOfDone: Global DoD.

Deterministic roadmap.json ledger, dependency-free resolver CLI (roadmap:status / roadmap:next / roadmap:validate) with --json, and tests/project-roadmap.test.ts enforcing structural, lifecycle, resolver, and curriculum-integration invariants.
AGENTS.md documents the mandatory entry protocol; docs/roadmap.md no longer duplicates pedagogical sequencing.
items.note: This ledger entry describes the infrastructure created by this change. It is DONE on the committed branch that contains these files.

items.title: Choose and add a repository LICENSE
definitionOfDone: A LICENSE file exists at the repository root and docs/sources.md / README reflect the chosen terms.

blocker.reason: Choosing a software license is a repository-owner decision. v0.1 intentionally ships with no LICENSE (all rights reserved). An agent must not select a license autonomously.
blocker.unblockedBy: The repository owner selects a license and adds a LICENSE file at the repository root.

items.note: Owner decision required. Recorded here so agents surface it instead of silently choosing.
